question: 我是 30 岁的成年人。根据你现有的 CDC 资料，每天睡眠时长的一般参考是多少？这个参考能直接当作对我的诊断吗？
answer: 不过，它**不能直接当作对你的诊断**。它只说明一个一般性的每日睡眠时长下限，既没有考虑你的实际睡眠记录、白天状态和健康状况，也不涉及睡眠质量、夜醒或分期；睡眠时长本身也无法用来判断疾病或某个变化的原因 [H1:AdultDuration][B1:Limits]。另外，这个“每天”的口径包含全天所有睡眠，而夜间记录并不等于全天总量，所以不能把某一晚的时长直接和它对照后就下结论 [B1:Limits]。

retrieved_evidence.title: CDC · About Sleep
retrieved_evidence.text: CDC lists at least seven hours of daily sleep as a general recommendation for adults aged 18–60. Sleep needs vary with age; this section does not state recommendations for other ages. This is a general daily reference, not a personalized diagnosis.

retrieved_evidence.title: NIH/NHLBI · Healthy Sleep Habits
retrieved_evidence.scope: Adult sleep habits and shift-work guidance
retrieved_evidence.text: Allow enough time for sleep. Keep bedtime and waking time consistent; NHLBI suggests limiting weekday–weekend differences to about one hour.
